original_source.author: A. Garrett Lisi
original_assertions: Table9 groups 18 xPhi root weights into 3 six-root sets in so(8), with 6 strong roots and 4 Cartan directions.
§2.4.1 presents factorization into 3 x and 6 colored/anti-colored Phi as a natural proposal, NOT a demonstrated uniqueness or mandatory theorem.
§3.1 treats x_a as 1-forms and Phi_c as shared Higgs 0-form roles; curvature Q=(xPhi)(xPhi) is nonseparable.
§3.2.2 flags the new-field bosonic action as speculative and its frame-derived Hodge as awkward.

project_model.carrier: chosen complex 8x8 J-orthogonal D4 root matrices, J=[[0,I4],[I4,0]], whose skew-Hermitian intersection defines one compact real so8
project_model.chosen_phase_class: Each generator root-vector lambda_(a,c) is restricted to signs +/-1; the original paper does not select these signs.
project_model.local_phase_plaquette_identity: For each color i, lambda_(1,ci)*lambda_(2,ai)-lambda_(1,ai)*lambda_(2,ci)=+2 for all admissible +/-1 compact-phase assignments.
project_model.rank_one_transport_plaquette_identity: For separable lambda_(a,c)=u_a*v_c, every 2x2 minor vanishes, including each color/anti-color plaquette.
project_model.consequence: Under these chosen conjugacy assumptions and sign-root completion family, a fully source-style 3x6 shared-Phi rank-one coordinate normalization cannot simultaneously realize compact skew-Hermitian operators for generic nonzero x1/x2 and Phi. This is only a chosen-model no-go, not an original source theory impossibility proof.

negative_controls.identity_root_signs: Project unphased root matrices do not satisfy the same chosen skew-Hermitian shared-Phi field reality for generic nonzero x1/x2.
negative_controls.last_round_compact_signs: lambda1 all +; lambda2 c1/c2/c3 -, lambda2 a1/a2/a3 +; lambda3 all +. Has 18 nonzero rank-one minors, minimal among the 512 sign completions.
negative_controls.separable_rephasing: Can preserve the shared-Phi rank-one coordinate family, but is incompatible with chosen compact dagger constraints when both x1 and x2 active.
